flowChecks.name: Duplicate merge, refresh persistence and exact PHP 325.50
Saved Pending order, matching totals, stock deducted and cart cleared
Matching admin order follows all four status actions to Completed
Admin UI edit persists; saved order keeps original name and unit price after refresh
Completed sales and normalized-email customer summary match the order

acceptanceChecks.note: Search, category and both price sorts work together; no-match and invalid-product pages are handled.
Duplicate additions merge, the cart survives refresh, and 2 x PHP 120.00 + PHP 85.50 equals PHP 325.50.
Empty/invalid checkout fields and invalid, fractional or excessive quantities are rejected.
Inactive/zero-stock items cannot be ordered. Price or availability changes require review before saving.
A saved Pending order appears in admin with matching items/total; stock decreases and purchased cart items clear. Failed writes preserve the cart.
Admin product/category changes reach the shop after refresh. Referenced products and assigned categories cannot be deleted.
Only allowed status transitions save. Eligible cancellation restores stock once, including after reload; failed writes do not change stock.
Sales include Completed orders only. Customers group normalized emails and use the latest submitted contact details.
Saved order names, unit prices and images survive catalog edits and reload. Browser data persists for the chosen LocalStorage approach.

Customer/admin layouts passed at 375, 768 and 1280 px in the recorded browser suite. The 45 replacement viewport screenshots have loaded images, labeled form inputs, no horizontal page overflow and no runtime errors.

one catalog search works from Home, categories and other pages at 1280px
product photo upload, replacement and image links persist at 375px
product photo upload, replacement and image links persist at 1280px
invalid, oversized and unreadable photos keep the previous image and form details
an uploaded JPEG stays in the form when storage fails and saves after retry
customer/admin layouts and navigation at 375px

customer/admin layouts and navigation at 1280px
typed product quantity is the quantity added by the next click

invalid quantities block purchasing and checkout; related products reset quantity
selected checkout connects to admin, completes, updates sales and preserves snapshots
Buy Now bypasses the cart and checkout details survive editing items
checkout rejects invalid fields and empty/invalid direct checkout
price changes require an explicit review; admin edits cannot overwrite purchased stock

typing stays available during queued quantity saves and checkout waits for the last one
an invalid draft remains blocked when an earlier quantity save finishes
malformed saved category images show recovery and preserve data until reset is confirmed
admin distinguishes empty browser data from filters hiding a saved guest order
resetting orders and sales keeps custom catalog, prices, inventory and cart after reload
failed orders reset keeps history and sales and permits retry

verification.scope: Automated Node tests and headless Chromium on Windows. No backend/database tests apply to this browser-only app. Physical devices, other browser engines, screen readers, exhaustive keyboard traversal and final hosting/video/access links were not verified.
verification.note: Only screenshot capture and documentation were updated for this refinement. The recorded 36 data tests, 32 browser tests and build were run earlier on the same unchanged application code.
